title: Prepare input data
action: Gather the provided end-member bulk moduli (B1=814 kbar, B2=693 kbar), nearest-neighbor distances (r0_CaF2=0.23655 nm, r0_SrF2=0.25096 nm), and the nine compositions with their mole fractions.
description: Organize the numerical inputs needed for the bulk modulus calculation.

title: Compute isothermal bulk moduli
action: For each composition, compute the bulk modulus B using the mixed-crystal formula with the given constants. Write the composition name and the computed B value in kbar to the output CSV.
description: Compute the mixed-crystal bulk modulus for nine compositions.
output_schema: CSV with exactly 9 rows and 2 columns: 'composition' (string) and 'B_kbar' (float). The composition strings must be exactly: CaF2, Ca90Sr10F2, Ca80Sr20F2, Ca70Sr30F2, Ca50Sr50F2, Ca40Sr60F2, Ca30Sr70F2, Ca10Sr90F2, SrF2, in that order.
